name: walnut
title: Walnut
description: Walnut from Raycast: quick answers, Ask Walnut, Tell Main, find a task. Needs Walnut running on this Mac.
author: openwalnut

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Tell Main
commands.subtitle: Walnut
commands.description: Type, then Enter to tell Main (fire and forget) or Cmd+Enter for a quick answer; matching tasks and notes list below.

commands.name: ask-selection
commands.title: Ask Walnut About Selection
commands.subtitle: Walnut
commands.description: Bring the selected text from the app you are in, then say what to do with it.

commands.name: walnut-ai
commands.title: Quick Answer
commands.subtitle: Walnut
commands.description: A fast answer from the model alone, in a couple of seconds, with follow-ups; Cmd+T hands the chat to Ask Walnut. Works as a fallback command: type anything in Raycast, then pick Quick Answer.

commands.name: walnut-ai-session
commands.title: Ask Walnut
commands.subtitle: Walnut
commands.description: Walnut does the work: a session in Walnut with your skills and tools (web search, files, your tasks), filed as an Ask Walnut chat; its reply shows here, with follow-ups. Works as a fallback command.

preferences.name: port
preferences.title: Walnut port
preferences.description: Where the local Walnut server listens
